_doc: Rule-only overlay rows (no geometry) for San Francisco plus the zoning-district control lookup used by the datasf_zoning source. nc_rule rows attach to a point through district_codes (exact DataSF zoning codes). alcohol_sud / special_use_district rows are copied onto the matching DataSF SUD polygons by name via sud_name_aliases.
_verified: Controls transcribed 2026-10-21 from the SF Planning Code zoning control tables (2026-08 edition, text as of 2026-09-23) via the gocodebook.com mirror; codelibrary.amlegal.com refused automated access (HTTP 403). source_url values point at amlegal (anchors taken from the DataSF zoning/SUD datasets; §§ 249.60 and 249.62 node ids from the amlegal dev mirror). First-story controls; P = principal, C = conditional, NP = prohibited. Corrected 2026-11-10 against the same edition (each change backed by a quote, see apps/api/tests/fixtures/pathway_cases.json): RH DTR controls and hours (Table 827; § 825(c)(1)(A)); NCT-MISSION story wording (Table 754); RH hours (Table 209.1; § 231(g)); Haight Street Alcohol RUSD licence types (§ 781.9(c)(1)(B)); North Beach Note 5 provisos (Table 722); Restaurant story wording for Tables 715, 723, 726, 730 and 762; Calle 24 SUD row (§ 249.59(d)); Mission Alcoholic Beverage SUD Restaurant control set to unknown (§ 249.60(f)(1)); Third Street Alcohol RUD Restaurant control set to unknown (§ 249.62(c)).

overlays.name: Mission Alcoholic Beverage Special Use District
overlays.rules: No new Liquor Stores. A Restaurant operating as a Bona Fide Eating Place may serve alcohol (licenses may be transferred in from inside or outside the SUD), as may non-profit theaters, bowling alleys/mini-golf with an integrated Restaurant, single-screen movie theaters (beer and wine) and ABC Type 90 music venues. A new or relocated Bar is considered under the underlying zoning but only as a Conditional Use, and must use a liquor license transferred from another Bar within the SUD. Existing liquor establishments may relocate or expand only with CU. East of the western boundary of the Mission Street NCT and north of Cesar Chavez Street, any new Restaurant requires CU and new ABC Type 75 (brewpub) licenses are prohibited. Good-neighbor operating conditions (§ 202.2 plus lighting and window-signage limits) apply.

overlays.name: Third Street Alcohol Restricted Use District
overlays.rules: No new on-sale (ABC Types 40, 42, 48, 57 — i.e. bars) or off-sale (Liquor Store) liquor establishments, except: ABC Type 2 and Type 23 sales, applications on file with ABC before May 19, 2003, temporary uses, and an ABC Type 42 on-sale establishment in the Bayview NCD with Conditional Use. Restaurants with ABC Types 41/47 are not 'on-sale liquor establishments' under this section. Pre-existing establishments may continue, re-establish within 10 years, and relocate within the RUD (CU, except P for a Bar).

overlays.name: Haight Street Alcohol Restricted Use Subdistrict
overlays.rules: Coterminous with the Haight Street NCD. New on-sale (ABC Types 40, 41, 42, 47, 48, 57 — bars and restaurants serving alcohol) or off-sale liquor establishments are permitted only as a Conditional Use. ABC Types 51, 52, 59, 60, 61, 64, 67, 70, 75 and 90 are not on-sale liquor establishments under this section. Existing establishments may continue; relocation within the subdistrict requires CU.

overlays.name: Lower Haight Street Alcohol Restricted Use District
overlays.rules: No new Liquor Stores (off-sale) in the NC-1 clusters at Haight/Scott and Haight/Pierce and the Lower Haight Street NCD between Steiner and Webster; Liquor Stores lawfully existing before March 25, 2007 may continue. The RUD does not itself restrict Bars or Restaurants — the underlying zoning controls apply.

overlays.name: North Beach Neighborhood Commercial District: bar and restaurant controls
overlays.rules: There is no separate North Beach alcohol SUD in the current Planning Code; North Beach bar and restaurant controls are in the North Beach NCD control table. Restaurants and Bars are Conditional Uses on the First Story only, and only in a space currently or last legally occupied by a Bar (for a new Bar) or by a Limited Restaurant, Restaurant or Bar (for a new Restaurant), as determined by the Zoning Administrator; no other use may convert to a Restaurant or Bar. The last use must not have been discontinued or abandoned (§§ 186.1(d), 178(d)) and the new use must not enlarge the space; no Conditional Use is required if the use remains the same as the prior authorized use with no enlargement or intensification. Limited Restaurants are P. Liquor Store C.
overlays.late_night_rule: Hours of operation (Table 722): P 6 a.m.–2 a.m.; NP 2 a.m.–6 a.m.

overlays.name: Taraval Street Restaurant Subdistrict
overlays.rules: Applies to the NC-1 portions of Taraval Street between 40th–41st and 45th–47th Avenues and the Inner Taraval Street NCD between 12th and 19th Avenues. Restaurants and Limited Restaurants are P on the First Story and below; Formula Retail Restaurants and Limited Restaurants are not permitted.

overlays.name: Geary Boulevard Formula Retail Pet Supply Store and Formula Retail Eating and Drinking Subdistrict
overlays.rules: Applies to the NC-3 portion of Geary Boulevard between 14th and 28th Avenues. Eating and Drinking uses that are also Formula Retail are not permitted; non-formula bars and restaurants follow the underlying NC-3 controls.

overlays.name: Calle 24 Special Use District
overlays.rules: A new Restaurant, Limited Restaurant or Bar, or the physical expansion of one, is prohibited where those uses exceed, or would exceed with the proposed use, 35% of the total commercial frontage within 300 feet of the site inside the SUD; a change from an existing Limited Restaurant to a Restaurant is exempt (§ 249.59(d)(1)). Conditional Use is required for a first-story commercial merger above 799 gross square feet and for a new non-residential use that replaces a Legacy Business (§ 249.59(d)(2)). For any commercial use that needs a Conditional Use, the Planning Commission must also find that the work conforms with the Calle 24 Design Guidelines and that the use supports at least four of the purposes of the SUD (§ 249.59(d)(3)).

overlays.name: Neighborhood Commercial base districts: bar and restaurant use
overlays.rules: In the base NC and NCT districts (NC-1, NC-2, NC-3, NC-S, NCT-1, NCT-2, NCT-3) a Bar and a Restaurant are principally permitted on the First Story. Exceptions: Bar is C in NC-1 and NC-2 within the Outer Sunset area (Table 710 Note 6 / Table 711 Note 9); in NCT-1 Bar takes the more restrictive control of any NC district or restricted use subdistrict within 1/4 mile (Table 750 Note 4). Named NCDs/NCTs have their own tables (see their rule rows); overlapping SUDs/RUDs (e.g. § 249.60, § 781.9, § 249.62) can add Conditional Use requirements.
overlays.late_night_rule: Hours of operation: NC-1 and NCT-1 P 6 a.m.–11 p.m., C 11 p.m.–2 a.m.; NC-2, NC-S, NCT-2 P 6 a.m.–2 a.m., C 2 a.m.–6 a.m.; NC-3 and NCT-3 no limit.
